https://source-0.example/aster-0.body:
Hidden navigation sentinel.

Aster passengers reserve a place before reaching the quay by choosing a crossing on the booking form.

The fictional ticket records the selected crossing and the passenger brings that ticket to the boarding gate.

The booking office keeps a paper copy of each reservation so stewards can check the crossing list.

passages.text: The released place becomes available on the same crossing when the booking office updates its list.

The fictional Aster trial serves residents of Luma Island who present a resident card when booking.

The island office keeps visitor requests on a separate list until the resident boarding period closes.
